name: Pasta
intro: Cherry tomatoes burst in olive oil. August does the work again.

variations.context: The simplest version. The tomatoes are the sauce.
If you have leftover roasted peppers, fold them in.
If you want heat and something salty at the end.

finish: Let the tomatoes sit in a hot pan with olive oil, undisturbed, until they start to burst — about 4 minutes. Then press gently and let the liquid reduce. Add garlic after, basil last, always after the heat is off.
